mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_orders (account_id, stock_code, side, quantity, limit_price, status, ordered_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{limitPrice}, #{status}, #{orderedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, stock_code, side, quantity, limit_price, status, filled_order_id, ordered_at, resolved_at FROM pending_orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, account_id, stock_code, side, quantity, limit_price, status, filled_order_id, ordered_at, resolved_at FROM pending_orders WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ordered_at

SELECT id, account_id, stock_code, side, quantity, limit_price, status, filled_order_id, ordered_at, resolved_at FROM pending_orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status != 'FILLED' ORDER BY ordered_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity * limit_price), 0) FROM pending_orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND side = 'BUY' AND status = 'PENDING'
